title: competition_ranks ported verbatim into demo_store instead of the shared/leaderboard module both packages already import
detail: Two verbatim copies of a parity-critical algorithm. If the server's tie semantics change, the demo copy drifts silently — recreating the exact parity-bug class this PR fixes. Violates AGENTS.md "DRY: extract helpers when logic repeats 2+ places".
recommended_fix: Hoist competition_ranks/do_competition_ranks into shared/leaderboard.gleam; import it from both demo_store and application_list_handler and delete the local copies (pure stdlib code, dual-target safe).
